title: Construction Lien Affidavit – Lone Star Mechanical v. Dillard Commercial Builders
text:
AFFIDAVIT OF MECHANIC'S AND MATERIALMAN'S LIEN

STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF HARRIS

BEFORE ME, the undersigned Notary Public, on this 15th day of April, 2025, personally appeared DEBORAH BRYANT, who being duly sworn, deposes and says:

1. My name is DEBORAH BRYANT. I am over the age of 21, of sound mind, and authorized to make this affidavit. I am the President of BRYANT LAW FIRM, PLLC, with offices at 4427 Elm Creek Drive, Suite 300, Houston, Texas 77002.

2. I am the duly authorized agent and counsel for the Claimant, LONE STAR MECHANICAL SERVICES, INC. (hereinafter "LSMS"), a Texas corporation with its principal place of business at 9880 Westpark Drive, Houston, Texas 77063.

3. The opposing party is DILLARD COMMERCIAL BUILDERS, LLC, a Texas limited liability company, with its registered address at 1200 Main Street, Suite 500, Houston, Texas 77002.

4. This Affidavit is made pursuant to Chapter 53 of the Texas Property Code, specifically §53.054, which states: "To perfect a lien, the person must file an affidavit with the county clerk of the county in which the property is located not later than the 15th day of the fourth month after the day on which the indebtedness accrues."

5. The property subject to this lien is legally described as Lot 7, Block 2, of the Greenway Park Addition, an addition to the City of Houston, Harris County, Texas, according to the plat thereof recorded in Volume 245, Page 78, Map Records of Harris County, Texas, and commonly known as 3312 Sage Road, Houston, Texas 77056 (the "Property").

6. The property owner is GREENWAY PARK OWNERS, LLC, a Texas limited liability company, whose registered agent for service is JAMES H. DILLARD, at 1200 Main Street, Suite 500, Houston, Texas 77002.

7. The original contractor for the improvements was DILLARD COMMERCIAL BUILDERS, LLC.

8. The improvements furnished by LSMS consisted of labor and materials for the installation of HVAC systems, ductwork, and mechanical equipment on the Property, pursuant to a written contract between LSMS and Dillard Commercial Builders, LLC, dated January 14, 2025 (the "Agreement").

9. The total contract price for the improvements was $487,500.00. LSMS has partially performed and has invoiced Dillard Commercial Builders, LLC in the amount of $312,400.00 for work completed through March 1, 2025. The sum of $312,400.00 remains unpaid and due.

10. The indebtedness accrued on March 1, 2025, when LSMS submitted its final invoice for work performed through that date.

11. The Claimant, LONE STAR MECHANICAL SERVICES, INC., hereby claims a lien on the Property to secure payment of the sum of $312,400.00, together with interest at 1.5% per month, attorney's fees, and costs.

12. The following individuals have knowledge of the facts stated herein: Michael Bryant, Project Manager for LSMS; Sarah J. Thomas, Chief Financial Officer of LSMS.

13. The case is currently pending in the 333rd Judicial District Court of Harris County, Texas, under Cause No. 2025-45678, styled LONE STAR MECHANICAL SERVICES, INC. v. DILLARD COMMERCIAL BUILDERS, LLC.

14. The presiding judge is the Honorable RICHARD O. MALONE, III. Counsel for the Plaintiff is DEBORAH BRYANT (Bar No. 24098765). Counsel for the Defendant is ANDREW CHASE (Bar No. 12345678).

15. The Social Security Number of the individual surety, JAMES H. DILLARD, is 458 29 7703 (also written as 458-29-7703). His date of birth is June 12, 1974.

16. The VIN for the company vehicle used by the project superintendent is 1HGCG1659WA029345, and the insurance policy number covering the work is POL-889012-01.

17. Bates stamp numbers: BRYANT00001 through BRYANT00045 appear on the attached exhibits.

18. The Affiant further states that the foregoing is a true and correct statement of the facts concerning the claim.

FURTHER AFFIANT SAYETH NOT.

________________________________
DEBORAH BRYANT

SWORN TO AND SUBSCRIBED before me on this 15th day of April, 2025, by DEBORAH BRYANT.

________________________________
Notary Public, State of Texas
My Commission Expires: October 31, 2027

(Exhibits referenced herein: Contract Agreement, Invoices, Correspondence, Bates BRYANT00001–BRYANT00045)

title: Construction Lien Affidavit – Farrow & Hale v. Ridgetop Construction
text:
AFFIDAVIT OF MECHANIC'S AND MATERIALMAN'S LIEN

STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF DALLAS

BEFORE ME, the undersigned Notary Public, on this 22nd day of February, 2025, personally appeared ROBERT J. FARROW, who being duly sworn, deposes and says:

1. My name is ROBERT J. FARROW. I am a Managing Partner of FARROW & HALE, LLP, a Texas limited liability partnership, with offices at 2100 Ross Avenue, Suite 400, Dallas, Texas 75201.

2. I am counsel for the Claimant, RIDGETOP CONSTRUCTION INC., a Texas corporation with its principal place of business at 4500 Belt Line Road, Suite 200, Addison, Texas 75001.

3. The opposing party is SUNBELT MATERIALS CO., a Texas corporation, with its registered address at 800 Commerce Street, Dallas, Texas 75202.

4. A subcontractor, JESSICA M. HALE, is also a named party in this proceeding. Ms. Hale is a project manager at Ridgetop Construction. She is sometimes referred to as J. M. Hale, or just Hale, or by her nickname Jess.

5. The property is located at 1420 Preston Road, Plano, Texas 75093, legally described as Lot 9, Block A, Preston Meadow Estates, according to the plat recorded in Volume 478, Page 35, Map Records of Collin County, Texas.

6. The improvements were performed under a subcontract dated August 5, 2024, between RIDGETOP CONSTRUCTION INC. (as general contractor) and SUNBELT MATERIALS CO. (as subcontractor). Sunbelt Materials was to furnish concrete, rebar, and related materials for the foundation and parking structure.

7. The total contract price was $1,250,000.00. Sunbelt Materials has been paid $600,000.00, but claims an additional $150,000.00 for extra work and materials provided under change orders. The balance of $150,000.00 is due and unpaid.

8. The Claimant, RIDGETOP CONSTRUCTION INC., disputes the amount and has filed a counterclaim. The case is pending in the 101st Judicial District Court of Dallas County, Texas, under Cause No. DC-25-07893, styled RIDGETOP CONSTRUCTION INC. v. SUNBELT MATERIALS CO.

9. The presiding judge is the Honorable MARIA G. ALVAREZ. Counsel for the Plaintiff is ROBERT J. FARROW (Bar No. 09876543). Counsel for the Defendant is JONATHAN R. KLINE (Bar No. 34567890).

10. The statutory basis is Texas Property Code §53.024, which reads: "A lien attaches in favor of an original contractor from the date the contract is filed for record in the county in which the property is located."

11. The Social Security Number of JESSICA M. HALE is 512 84 6671 (also written as 512-84-6671). Her date of birth is March 3, 1985.

12. The VIN of the company truck assigned to Jess is 3C6UR5DL9HG123456, and the company's insurance policy number is CGL-4567-2024.

13. Bates numbers: FARROW0001 through FARROW0078 are stamped on all exhibits.

14. The Affiant states that the foregoing is true and correct.

________________________________
ROBERT J. FARROW

SWORN TO AND SUBSCRIBED before me on this 22nd day of February, 2025, by ROBERT J. FARROW.

________________________________
Notary Public, State of Texas
My Commission Expires: August 15, 2028

(Exhibits: Contract, Change Orders, Correspondence, Bates FARROW0001–FARROW0078)

title: Construction Lien Affidavit – Kerns v. Westside Development Group
text:
AFFIDAVIT OF MECHANIC'S AND MATERIALMAN'S LIEN

STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF TRAVIS

BEFORE ME, the undersigned Notary Public, on this 10th day of March, 2025, personally appeared WILLIAM T. KERNS, who being duly sworn, deposes and says:

1. My name is WILLIAM T. KERNS. I am a partner in the law firm KERNS & ASSOCIATES, P.C., with offices at 100 Congress Avenue, Suite 1200, Austin, Texas 78701.

2. I am counsel for the Claimant, WESTSIDE DEVELOPMENT GROUP, INC., a Texas corporation with its principal place of business at 5000 Bee Cave Road, Suite 100, Austin, Texas 78746.

3. The opposing party is AUSTIN ROOFING SOLUTIONS, LLC, a Texas limited liability company, with its registered address at 8900 Burnet Road, Austin, Texas 78757.

4. The property subject to this lien is located at 2200 South Lamar Boulevard, Austin, Texas 78704, legally described as Lot 12, Block F, Zilker Park Addition, Travis County, Texas, per Volume 312, Page 99, Map Records of Travis County.

5. The improvements were performed under a contract dated October 1, 2024, wherein Austin Roofing Solutions, LLC agreed to install a new commercial roofing system on the building owned by Westside Development Group, Inc. The contract price was $220,000.00.

6. Austin Roofing Solutions completed the work on December 15, 2024, but Westside Development Group has refused to pay the final invoice of $55,000.00, citing alleged defects.

7. The Claimant, Westside Development Group, Inc., through its counsel William T. Kerns (Bar No. 56789012), now files this lien to secure its claim for breach of contract.

8. The case is pending in the 200th Judicial District Court of Travis County, Texas, under Cause No. D-1-GN-25-001234, styled WESTSIDE DEVELOPMENT GROUP, INC. v. AUSTIN ROOFING SOLUTIONS, LLC.

9. The presiding judge is the Honorable CATHERINE L. WRIGHT. Counsel for the Defendant is LAURA M. CHEN (Bar No. 65432109).

10. The relevant statute is Texas Property Code §53.056, which provides: "A lien claimant may file an affidavit for lien with the county clerk of the county in which the property is located without court order."

11. The Social Security Number of the project supervisor, DANIEL J. KERNS (son of William, and company estimator), is 667 01 2345 (also written as 667-01-2345). His date of birth is April 8, 1990.

12. The VIN for the roof inspection vehicle is 1FTFW1EFXHFA12345, and the insurance policy number for the project is BOP-77665-2024.

13. Bates stamps: KERNS0001 through KERNS0033 appear on the attached exhibits.

14. The Affiant further states that the foregoing is true and correct.

________________________________
WILLIAM T. KERNS

SWORN TO AND SUBSCRIBED before me on this 10th day of March, 2025, by WILLIAM T. KERNS.

________________________________
Notary Public, State of Texas
My Commission Expires: January 31, 2029

title: Construction Lien Affidavit – Pennington v. Meridian Framing
text:
AFFIDAVIT OF MECHANIC'S AND MATERIALMAN'S LIEN

STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF BEXAR

BEFORE ME, the undersigned Notary Public, on this 5th day of May, 2025, personally appeared ANGELA M. PENNINGTON, who being duly sworn, deposes and says:

1. My name is ANGELA M. PENNINGTON. I am a partner at PENNINGTON LEGAL GROUP, LLC, with offices at 112 East Pecan Street, Suite 800, San Antonio, Texas 78205.

2. I am counsel for the Claimant, MERIDIAN FRAMING & CONSTRUCTION, LLC, a Texas limited liability company with its principal place of business at 4321 Broadway Street, San Antonio, Texas 78209.

3. The opposing party is ALAMO COMMERCIAL REALTY, INC., a Texas corporation, with its registered address at 2000 NW Loop 410, Suite 200, San Antonio, Texas 78213.

4. The property is located at 7500 San Pedro Avenue, San Antonio, Texas 78216, legally described as Lot 5, Block 3, North Star Addition, Bexar County, Texas, per Volume 89, Page 12, Map Records of Bexar County.

5. The improvements were performed under a subcontract dated November 15, 2024, between Meridian Framing & Construction, LLC (subcontractor) and Alamo Commercial Realty, Inc. (general contractor), for framing and rough carpentry on a mixed-use development.

6. The subcontract price was $975,000.00. Meridian Framing has completed 100% of its scope and has invoiced Alamo Commercial Realty in the amount of $975,000.00. To date, only $700,000.00 has been paid, leaving a balance of $275,000.00.

7. The Claimant files this lien to secure payment of $275,000.00, plus interest and fees.

8. The case is pending in the 57th Judicial District Court of Bexar County, Texas, under Cause No. 2025-CI-04567, styled MERIDIAN FRAMING & CONSTRUCTION, LLC v. ALAMO COMMERCIAL REALTY, INC.

9. The presiding judge is the Honorable SUZANNE K. PARKER. Counsel for the Plaintiff is ANGELA M. PENNINGTON (Bar No. 11223344). Counsel for the Defendant is MARK A. DELGADO (Bar No. 44332211).

10. The applicable statute is Texas Property Code §53.083, which states: "A lien is perfected when the affidavit is filed and notice is given to the property owner."

11. The Social Security Number of the managing member of Meridian Framing, RONALD J. PENNINGTON (Angela's brother, and known as Ron), is 789 33 2468 (also written as 789-33-2468). His date of birth is September 22, 1978.

12. The VIN for the company forklift is 4T4BF1FK5GR123456, and the insurance policy number is GL-2000-2025.

13. Bates numbers: PENNINGTON0001 through PENNINGTON0055 appear on the attached exhibits.

14. The Affiant states that the foregoing is true and correct.

________________________________
ANGELA M. PENNINGTON

SWORN TO AND SUBSCRIBED before me on this 5th day of May, 2025, by ANGELA M. PENNINGTON.

________________________________
Notary Public, State of Texas

title: Construction Lien Affidavit – Whitfield v. Capstone Developers
text:
AFFIDAVIT OF MECHANIC'S AND MATERIALMAN'S LIEN

STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF TARRANT

BEFORE ME, the undersigned Notary Public, on this 18th day of June, 2025, personally appeared JENNIFER L. WHITFIELD, who being duly sworn, deposes and says:

1. My name is JENNIFER L. WHITFIELD. I am a member of WHITFIELD & WARD, LLP, with offices at 500 West 7th Street, Suite 1500, Fort Worth, Texas 76102.

2. I am counsel for the Claimant, CAPSTONE DEVELOPERS, LLC, a Texas limited liability company with its principal place of business at 3000 Camp Bowie Boulevard, Fort Worth, Texas 76107.

3. The opposing party is TRINITY ELECTRIC, INC., a Texas corporation, with its registered address at 1100 South Freeway, Fort Worth, Texas 76104.

4. The property is located at 4500 River Oaks Boulevard, Fort Worth, Texas 76114, legally described as Lot 16, Block C, River Oaks Addition, Tarrant County, Texas, per Volume 567, Page 88, Map Records of Tarrant County.

5. The improvements were performed under a contract dated December 1, 2024, between Capstone Developers, LLC (owner) and Trinity Electric, Inc. (contractor), for electrical systems installation in a new apartment complex. The contract price was $1,800,000.00.

6. Trinity Electric completed all work by March 1, 2025. Capstone Developers paid $1,400,000.00 but withholds $400,000.00, alleging that the work was not up to code. Trinity Electric disputes this and has filed this lien.

7. The Claimant, Trinity Electric, Inc., through its attorney JENNIFER L. WHITFIELD (Bar No. 77889900), asserts a lien for $400,000.00.

8. The case is pending in the 96th Judicial District Court of Tarrant County, Texas, under Cause No. 2025-12345, styled TRINITY ELECTRIC, INC. v. CAPSTONE DEVELOPERS, LLC.

9. The presiding judge is the Honorable MICHAEL S. GRANT. Counsel for the Defendant is KEVIN M. NGUYEN (Bar No. 55667788).

10. The statutory authority is Texas Property Code §53.105, which reads: "A lien may be transferred if the lienholder assigns the debt secured by the lien in writing."

11. The Social Security Number of the project manager for Trinity Electric, DEREK R. WHITFIELD (Jennifer's cousin, known as Derek), is 334 56 7890 (also written as 334-56-7890). His date of birth is November 5, 1982.

12. The VIN for the service van is 2FTRX18L0XCA12345, and the insurance policy number is COMM-1234-2025.

13. Bates numbers: WHITFIELD0001 through WHITFIELD0062 appear on the attached exhibits.

14. The Affiant further states that the foregoing is true and correct.

________________________________
JENNIFER L. WHITFIELD

SWORN TO AND SUBSCRIBED before me on this 18th day of June, 2025, by JENNIFER L. WHITFIELD.

________________________________
Notary Public, State of Texas
